messages:
Emma (CS): Quick heads-up — Horizon Retail submitted a new request this morning: they want a custom product-recommendation reranker + short explanation generator, must avoid PHI/PII and must be auditable for their Q3 renewal review.
Raj - Solutions Eng: Copy. Do we have their dataset yet?
Emma (CS): They uploaded a sample CSV (anonymized but still has customer IDs). Link: https://redwood.internal/uploads/hr-retail-sample.csv
Marta (Applied ML): I skimmed. IDs are pseudonymous, but there are free-text notes that could contain PHI if mapped. Recommend a data-sensitivity pass before model training.
Oliver (Security): +1 on sensitivity pass. Also they want KMS-backed keys for model artifacts per their contract clause 4.2. Need to confirm VPC/network boundary for Private deployments.
Emma (CS): Horizon is currently on a Dedicated plan but asking to pilot Private for this workload because of the renewal negotiation. They flagged SLA + auditability as must-haves.
Raj - Solutions Eng: For the reranker, do they require a specific model family? They mentioned "high-recall" earlier. Might be better to propose a 7B quantized variant with reranker head.
Marta (Applied ML): Suggest we run a dual-eval: relevance (MRR@10) + safety regression on a 2000-case prompt set. I'll prepare eval harness and a baseline with redwood/7b-rerank-v1.
Emma (CS): Timeline: customer wants a readiness demo before renewal call on 2026-05-04. That gives ~6 weeks. Is that feasible?
Raj - Solutions Eng: 6 weeks is tight but doable if we scope a canary: eval + demo on sample data, not full private deployment. I'll own integration patches.
Oliver (Security): For the demo, require masking of any residual identifiers and an audit log showing model inputs/outputs. Also need a compliance-ready runbook for the customer-facing demo.
Marta (Applied ML): I'll add automated PII detectors to the eval pipeline. If we detect likely PHI, we'll flag and route to a data reviewer before any model update.
Emma (CS): Who will own the risk note for renewal? Horizon's CSM wants a short risk summary for the renewal packet.
Raj - Solutions Eng: I can draft the tech risk blurb (latency, expected throughput, tradeoffs with quantization). Marta can add model-quality risk (regressions, safety mitigations).
Oliver (Security): I'll provide the security/compliance addendum and a checklist: KMS enrolled, VPC endpoints reviewed, audit log retention policy.
Emma (CS): Perfect — let's sync tomorrow 11am PT for handoff. Action items: Raj — integration plan + demo scope; Marta — eval harness + PII filters; Oliver — compliance checklist; Emma — draft renewal risk summary for CSM.
deploy-bot: Reminder: any canary deployment to dedicated must pass the "no-leak" gating tests before traffic routing.
Raj - Solutions Eng: Noted. I'll schedule the canary and include the gating tests.
Marta (Applied ML): Uploading initial eval manifest to: https://redwood.internal/evals/hr-rerank/manifest.csv — will update by EOD.
Emma (CS): Thanks team. I'll confirm the 11am PT invite and add Horizon's CSM to the thread.
Emma (CS): @Horizon-CS FYI — internal team is aligning; will share demo plan after tomorrow's sync. :thumbsup:
